All 12/12 events tests pass including shrimp_hatched_event_reports_limiting_causes_when_suppressed which verifies LowOxygen + LowMinerals cause codes and 'limited by' summary text on partially-suppressed ShrimpHatched events.
Full tank_core test suite passes: 0 failures across 42 test binaries (500+ total tests). Full tank_data (41 tests), tank_scenarios (40+5 tests), tank_harness (38 tests) all pass with 0 failures.
cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings passes clean. cargo fmt --all --check passes clean.

ShrimpHatched events now report limiting factors when hatch_rate < PARTIAL_HATCH_DIAGNOSTIC_THRESHOLD (0.8) via hatch_outcome_causes() which checks oxygen, temperature, minerals, stability, TAN, nitrite, and starvation. Summary includes 'limited by ...' text identifying the suppressing factors. Addresses amendment fr-7-ae2bf47c.

test_chemistry_stress_suppresses_breeding (reproduction_factors.rs:445-511) now independently tests all three chemistry axes: TAN at 2 mg/L, NO2 at 1.5 mg/L, and low GH (calcium 10 mg/L, magnesium 2 mg/L per liter). Each is asserted below 70% of clean baseline. Addresses amendment fr-7-5d1c7cc7.
crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs is tracked in git (git ls-files confirms). All 6 tests pass. Addresses amendment fr-7-e6495363.

reproductive_readiness_factors() computes all 8 named factors: temperature, condition, minerals (GH), stability, molt_stress, density, tan, nitrite — each backed by species parameters in ShrimpRuntimeParams and neocaridina_davidi.toml.

TankSnapshot exposes repro_dominant_suppression field via dominant_repro_suppression_label() which reports the minimum factor label when below 0.8, covering all 8 factors. Tests verify correct label attribution for temperature, molt_stress, tan, nitrite, and minerals scenarios.
Density suppression applies immediately to spawning via min(reproductive_readiness_index, density_factor), not gated behind the EMA lag.

test_mature_stable_tank_breeds_well requires berried_events >= 3 AND hatched_events >= 3 (complete reproductive cycles), population growth, and controlled chemistry (TAN < 0.6, NO2 < 0.6, instability < 0.35).

test_neglected_tank_breeding_stalls requires chemistry/stability degradation (TAN > 0.5 || NO2 > 0.2 AND instability > 0.15), final population <= initial, underperformance vs maintained control, and active dominant suppression factor.

Egg-dropping model uses both instability_pressure and temp_swing_pressure (max of both), capped at egg_drop_max_probability (named parameter). Test requires emitted drop events AND observable berried/egg count reduction (AND logic).

All previously hardcoded condition constants are now named parameters with full lifecycle: condition_do_reference_mg_l, condition_nh3_sensitivity, condition_nitrite_sensitivity, condition_hourly_stress_penalty_weight, temp_condition_min_factor, temp_condition_low_divisor_c, temp_condition_high_divisor_c, reproductive_readiness_smoothing, egg_drop_max_probability, egg_oxygen_reference_mg_l, full_clutch_condition_threshold.
findings_or_gaps: Three warm-side temperature curve-shape constants (LOW_TEMP_REPRO_MIN_FACTOR=0.1, HIGH_TEMP_REPRO_SHOULDER_FACTOR=0.5, MIN_REPRO_SUPPRESSION_FACTOR=0.05) remain as file-level named constants rather than species parameters. These are documented as intentionally fixed for the first-pass model (comment at shrimp.rs:1598-1600) and the primary curve-width parameter has been extracted. Noted in multiple prior review cycles and accepted each time. Not blocking.

The condition factor in reproductive_readiness_factors() (line 1539) has no minimum floor, unlike density/TAN/nitrite which clamp to MIN_REPRO_SUPPRESSION_FACTOR=0.05. At condition_index=0.0 the product zeroes out. This is intentional: condition is an internal body-state signal where zero correctly halts reproduction during catastrophic health. The planner position on amendment fr-7-8e8338a4 rejected adding a floor for this reason, which I concur with.
follow_up_or_amendments: If future tuning requires it, promote the three warm-side temperature curve-shape constants to ShrimpRuntimeParams. Low priority — documented named constants with the primary curve parameters already tunable.
